children.name: hello-world.md
children.title: Hello World
children.content:
# Hello World

Welcome to my self-hosted blog.

This site is a static page. The file list you see is a JSON configuration file. To add a new article, edit `site.config.json` and run `node build.js` again.

## What you can do

- Add a file node under any directory
- Set a `title`, a `date` and a list of `tags`
- Write the body in Markdown
- Link a `href` to open an external page instead of inline content

children.name: dracula-theme.md
children.title: Why I Chose Dracula
children.content:
# Why I Chose Dracula

The Dracula palette is dark, warm and readable for long sessions.

- Background `#282A36`
- Foreground `#F8F8F2`
- Accent `#BD93F9`

Every color used by this component comes from `DRACULA.md`.

children.name: tui-in-the-browser.md
children.title: TUI in the Browser
children.content:
# TUI in the Browser

A TUI style does not need a terminal. The look comes from a monospace font, right-angle borders and box-drawing characters.

The directory tree uses `├─`, `└─` and `│`. Panels always keep `border-radius: 0`.
